body:
Extending the boot-splash claim with two adjacent asks from the user: persistent user settings and an
optional in-app API key field. New paths beyond the original claim: app/renderer/core/settings.ts (new),
app/renderer/App.tsx, app/renderer/shell/ConfigDrawer.tsx, app/renderer/hooks/useSidecar.ts (artifact
stripping), server/appserver/main.py (api_key pass-through, one line), app/README.md.

Design: settings.json under Electron userData holds model {base_url, model, api_key_env}, world, world
field values, goal — hydrated on launch, saved debounced on change. The key VALUE is never persisted:
a password field holds it in renderer memory for the session only, passes to the sidecar per run, is
stripped from saved artifacts, and the env-var name path stays supported (pasted key wins for the run).
